svg.font-family: 'Visual Anything Roboto', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Claim journey
svg.desc:
Jordan’s knee, from the visit through the authorization and the claim to Harbor’s decision.
Its long description, an outline of every shape and relation, is in “Clinic claim - Claim journey.md”.
